lines: Revenue was $1.16 billion, up 5% year over year; ex-China revenue was $1.10 billion, up 8%.
GAAP operating margin was 17.4%; non-GAAP operating margin was 23.7%.
GAAP diluted EPS was $2.16 and non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.35.
For 2026, Illumina initially guided to total company revenue of $4.5-$4.6 billion, representing 4%-6% reported growth.
Revenue was $1.091 billion, up 4.8% year over year.
GAAP operating margin was 19.2%; non-GAAP operating margin was 21.9%.
GAAP diluted EPS was $0.87 and non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.15.
Illumina raised 2026 guidance to $4.52-$4.62 billion of revenue and $5.15-$5.30 of non-GAAP diluted EPS.
Revenue was $1.159 billion, up 9.5% year over year; rest-of-world organic revenue grew 8.1%.
GAAP operating margin was 21.1%; non-GAAP operating margin was 22.5%.
GAAP diluted EPS was $1.35 and non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.31.
Illumina raised 2026 guidance to $4.60-$4.64 billion of revenue, greater than 5% rest-of-world organic growth, and $5.30-$5.40 of non-GAAP diluted EPS.
Q3 revenue was $1.129 billion, up 4.2% year over year; excluding tariff refunds, revenue was $1.166 billion.
GAAP operating margin was 27.0%; non-GAAP operating margin was 28.8% (25.0% excluding tariff refunds).
GAAP diluted EPS was $1.43; non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.62 ($1.44 excluding tariff refunds).
Q3 operating cash flow was $419 million and free cash flow was $378 million.
2026 guidance excluding tariff refunds raised to $4.64-$4.66 billion revenue and $5.40-$5.45 non-GAAP diluted EPS; strong clinical demand and NovaSeq X placements cited.
